commands.name: template-and-project-settings-drop-ecc
commands.run:
python3 -c "import json; t=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')); p=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))
for d in (t, p):
    assert 'ecc@ecc' not in d.get('enabledPlugins', {}), 'plugin declared'
    assert 'ecc' not in d.get('extraKnownMarketplaces', {}), 'marketplace declared'
    assert d['enabledPlugins'].get('superpowers@claude-plugins-official') is True, 'superpowers missing'
assert not [k for k in t.get('env', {}) if k.startswith(('ECC_', 'GATEGUARD_'))], 'ecc env left'
assert '{{CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}}' not in open('claude/settings.json.tmpl').read(), 'token left'"

commands.name: reconcile-retires-ecc-hermetically
commands.run: d="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ecc-reconcile.XXXXXX")"; mkdir -p "$d/.claude-work"; printf '%s\n' '{"enabledPlugins":{"ecc@ecc":true,"other@m":true},"extraKnownMarketplaces":{"ecc":{"source":{"source":"git","url":"https://example.invalid/e.git"}},"other":{"source":{"source":"git","url":"https://example.invalid/o.git"}}},"env":{"ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS":"a","ECC_AGENT_DATA_HOME":"/x","ECC_PLAN_CANVAS_STATE_DIR":"/x/p","ECC_CONTEXT_MONITOR_COST_WARNINGS":"0","GATEGUARD_BASH_ROUTINE_DISABLED":"1","GATEGUARD_EXEMPT_GLOBS":"/**","MACHINE_LOCAL":"keep"}}' > "$d/.claude-work/settings.json"; ok=1; if HOME="$d" DOTFILEDIR="$PWD" sh -c '. install/common/claude-links.sh && reconcile_claude_settings_file claude/settings.json.tmpl "$1" >/dev/null && cp "$1" "$1.first" && reconcile_claude_settings_file claude/settings.json.tmpl "$1" >/dev/null && cmp -s "$1" "$1.first"' _ "$d/.claude-work/settings.json" && python3 -c "import json,sys; s=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert s['enabledPlugins']['ecc@ecc'] is False; assert s['enabledPlugins']['other@m'] is True; assert s['enabledPlugins']['superpowers@claude-plugins-official'] is True; assert 'ecc' not in s['extraKnownMarketplaces'] and 'other' in s['extraKnownMarketplaces']; assert not [k for k in s['env'] if k.startswith(('ECC_', 'GATEGUARD_'))]; assert s['env']['MACHINE_LOCAL'] == 'keep'; assert 'plan-canvas' not in json.dumps(s)" "$d/.claude-work/settings.json"; then ok=0; fi; rm -rf "$d"; exit $ok

commands.name: retired-zsh-functions-undefined-after-reload
commands.run: h="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ecc-zsh.XXXXXX")"; env -i HOME="$h" PATH=/usr/bin:/bin DOTFILEDIR="$PWD" zsh -c 'for f in ecc-install ecc-update _ecc_legacy_rules_notice _codex_stage_ecc_plugin _codex_install_ecc_plugin _codex_update_ecc_plugin _claude_plugin_check_update _claude_plugin_epoch_write; do eval "function $f { : }"; done; source zsh/functions.zsh >/dev/null 2>&1; for f in ecc-install ecc-update _ecc_legacy_rules_notice _codex_stage_ecc_plugin _codex_install_ecc_plugin _codex_update_ecc_plugin _claude_plugin_check_update _claude_plugin_epoch_write; do (( ${+functions[$f]} )) && exit 1; done; (( ${+functions[ecc-uninstall]} )) && (( ${+functions[_ecc_sweep_legacy_vendored]} )) && (( ${+functions[superpowers-install]} ))'; rc=$?; rm -rf "$h"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && ! grep -nE '^ECC_REPO_URL=|^_claude_plugin_check_update$' zsh/functions.zsh && grep -qF '_ecc_sweep_legacy_vendored "$ecc_dir"' zsh/functions.zsh
